headline: Not optimized: spikes stayed on Cheap, bill ~5x the best possible.
text: ISP tried to shift traffic spikes to Expensive, whose billing would have absorbed them nearly free, but its route priorities never actually moved traffic. The spikes set Cheap's bill at about $511 versus a best possible $102, and ISP left conflicting routes to Remote behind.
